country.name: Egypt
country.jurisdictionNotice: Ministry-supervised pre-university education, technical education and higher education are distinct from Al-Azhar’s separate system of pre-university institutes. Governorate, institution category, regulator and exact program authority must remain visible.
country.languagePolicy: Arabic is the official language and primary national instructional context. Language schools, international programs, minority and accessibility contexts require exact language, institution type, curriculum authorization and local review; translation is not localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Egyptian reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, Al-Azhar authority, governorate, NAQAAE or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of Education and Technical Education governs its pre-university and technical-education system; Al-Azhar governs its distinct institutes; the Ministry of Higher Education, relevant university councils and NAQAAE have separate higher-education and quality roles.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official school or institute identifier, governorate, locality, stage, school type, supervising system, sector, authorization, current operation and source date. Search results and statistical enumeration are not current authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution establishment or listing, operating authority, exact program approval, Supreme Council recognition, NAQAAE institutional accreditation, NAQAAE program accreditation and qualification-register status are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education and Technical Education
authorities.role: general and technical pre-university education, curriculum, examinations and school administration

authorities.name: Education directorates in the governorates
authorities.role: territorial school administration and current school-record validation

authorities.name: Al-Azhar pre-university education sector
authorities.role: Al-Azhar primary, preparatory and secondary institutes and their curriculum

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
Supreme Council of Universities and competent university councils
authorities.role: degree, equivalency and institutional or program decisions within their mandates

authorities.name: National Authority for Quality Assurance and Accreditation of Education (NAQAAE)
authorities.role: institutional and program accreditation and national qualifications framework

authorities.name: Personal Data Protection Center
authorities.role: personal-data licensing, permits, compliance and oversight

authorities.name: National Council for Childhood and Motherhood

curriculum.authority: Competent Ministry curriculum authority or Al-Azhar authority for its separate system
curriculum.title: Official curricula and specifications by system, stage, grade, subject, language and school year
curriculum.implementationRule: A news item, electronic resource, examination model, textbook or distribution schedule is not by itself the controlling curriculum. Verify supervising system, stage, grade, subject, language, school type, approving instrument, version and school year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Ministry curriculum, Al-Azhar curriculum, technical specialization, international curriculum, examination specification, textbook and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry, responsible governorate directorate or Al-Azhar authority
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The Ministry links an Egyptian school guide, while CAPMAS enumerates Ministry and Al-Azhar schools and institutes for stated school years. Neither should be treated as proof that every listed institution, branch or program is currently authorized and operating. Verify the competent system and territorial record.
requiredRecordFields: stage, school type, technical specialization and language
public, private, national, international or other sector
observation date, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: CAPMAS with source ministries and Al-Azhar
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The 2023/2024 pre-university bulletin covers Ministry schools and Al-Azhar institutes nationwide and was released as a dated administrative-statistics product. Preserve school year, release, system, stage, governorate, sector, definition and denominator. It is not a live authorization directory.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Ministry of Education and Technical Education, competent training authority and NAQAAE within their mandates
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Technical-school type, provider authorization, exact specialization, occupational standard, assessment, awarding authority, qualification-framework inclusion and accreditation are separate claims.

higherEducation.authority: Ministry of Higher Education, competent councils and NAQAAE
higherEducation.authorityNotice: A ministry category or institution list does not authorize every campus, program, modality or award. Legal establishment, current operation, exact program approval, degree authority, Supreme Council recognition, NAQAAE institutional accreditation, program accreditation and qualification-register inclusion must be verified separately. A blacklist notice is not a complete positive register.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and applicable executive regulations
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Child Law No. 12 of 1996, as amended including Laws No. 126 of 2008 and No. 186 of 2023, plus current sector procedures
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Verify current commencement and transitional requirements, licences or permits, DPO obligations, sensitive and biometric data, children’s data, cross-border transfer, retention, security and incidents with the PDPC. Current school and Al-Azhar reporting, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures must be approved before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Arabic national curricula, Al-Azhar curricula, official language schools, international curricula, sign-language and accessibility resources, and Nubian or other community-language contexts are distinct. Preserve script, institution type, curriculum authority, locality and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Egyptian education reviewer is named.
Ministry, governorate, Al-Azhar, technical, higher-education, council and accreditation responsibilities are verified.
A verified current all-system school and institute directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves school year, release date, source system, stage, governorate, sector, definition and denominator.
Every curriculum record preserves supervising system, stage, grade, subject or specialization, language, instrument, version and school year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution category, campus, exact program, award, decision, accreditation, recognition and validity.
PDPC compliance and current Ministry and Al-Azhar child-safeguarding procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
Arabic, Al-Azhar, language-school, international, accessibility and community-language contexts remain distinct.
